issues.body: malformed_lexical_forms_fail_instead_of_reading_back_a_substituted_value includes " 7" among malformed xsd:integer lexical forms. XML Schema fixes the whiteSpace facet for integer to collapse, so leading/trailing whitespace is normalized before lexical-to-value mapping; this literal should decode as 7 rather than be rejected. The test would lock in non-conformant behavior in decode_i128.
issues.fix_hint: Remove " 7" from the rejection cases and add a positive witness that whitespace-padded/tab/newline-separated boundary whitespace is collapsed and decoded correctly. Update decode_i128 to apply XML Schema whitespace collapse before parsing while still rejecting internal whitespace such as "+ 1".
issues.title: Test incorrectly requires rejection of a valid whitespace-collapsed xsd:integer

verdict.summary: The new integration tests exercise the real Store readback path and cover useful boundary, datatype, error, and fixed-point behavior. However, one test encodes an incorrect XML Schema integer lexical-space assumption: xsd:integer has a fixed whiteSpace facet of collapse, so a whitespace-padded form such as " 7" denotes a valid integer after whitespace normalization. Requiring decode_i128 to reject it makes the public codec less conformant and turns that behavior into a regression constraint.
